eps.ov: Yashiro Nene is looking for ghostly help with her love life, but when "Hanako-san," the wish-granting spirit that haunts a girls’ bathroom stall, turns out to be a boy, she may end up getting more, and less, than she bargained for.
eps.oa: تبحث «نيني ياشيرو» عن عون من الأشباح في حياتها العاطفية، لكن حين يتبين أن «هاناكو سان»، الروح التي تحقق الأمنيات وتسكن إحدى حجرات دورة مياه البنات، فتى لا فتاة، قد تنال أكثر مما توقعت وأقل.

eps.ov: A rash of mysterious thefts hits the school, and rumor has it that the apparition "Yousei-san" is behind it. When Nene catches sight of the creature, will she end up losing more than just her school supplies?
eps.oa: موجة سرقات غامضة تضرب المدرسة، والشائعات تقول إن الشبح «يوسي-سان» وراءها. وحين تلمح «نيني» الكائن، أتخسر أكثر من أدواتها المدرسية؟

eps.ov: Nene’s best friend vanishes without a trace and no one else remembers she ever existed! To get her friend back, Nene is forced to call on Hanako for help and journey into a "Boundary" between the world of the living and the world of the dead.
eps.oa: تختفي أعز صديقات «نيني» بلا أثر، ولا أحد غيرها يذكر أنها وُجدت أصلاً! ولتستعيد صديقتها تضطر نيني إلى الاستعانة بـ«هاناكو» والسفر إلى «الحدود» بين عالم الأحياء وعالم الأموات.

eps.ov: Nene, Hanako, and Kou have reached the top of the Misaki Stairs, where a mysterious and bewitching woman awaits them. Will Nene get her friend back, or will she vanish along with her?
eps.oa: بلغ «نيني» و«هاناكو» و«كو» أعلى «درج ميساكي»، وهناك تنتظرهم امرأة غامضة فاتنة. فهل تستعيد نيني صديقتها، أم تختفي معها؟

eps.ov: The school is full on unlikely couples thanks to a tree that rumor has it makes any confession made under it succeed. When Hanako asks Nene to meet him there, Nene starts to suspect that he sees her as more than an assistant.
eps.oa: تمتلئ المدرسة بثنائيات لا يُتوقع اجتماعها، بفضل شجرة تقول الشائعات إن كل اعتراف بالحب تحتها ينجح. وحين يطلب «هاناكو» من «نيني» أن تلقاه هناك، تبدأ نيني تظن أنه يراها أكثر من مساعدة.

eps.ov: In search of Hanako’s secrets, Nene and Kou enter the fifth Wonder, the 4 O’clock Library. Its books contain the past and future of every student their school has ever had, but some knowledge comes at a price.
eps.oa: بحثاً عن أسرار «هاناكو» يدخل «نيني» و«كو» الأعجوبة الخامسة، «مكتبة الساعة الرابعة». وفي كتبها ماضي كل طالب عرفته مدرستهم ومستقبله، لكن بعض المعرفة له ثمن.

eps.ov: Nene’s relationship with Hanako becomes strained after she learns about his past. With some baking help from Kou, she tries to talk things out with Hanako over donuts, but their heart-to-heart is interrupted by a shocking intruder!

Kou gets more than he bargained for when he tries to help a student’s ghost rest in peace. The late Mitsuba may look delicate, but his language is anything but. Can Kou put up with him long enough to help him?

After a surprise invitation, Nene finds herself kidnapped and taken to... a fancy tea party? Nene quickly drops her guard in coversation with the beautiful and mysterious Sakura, but is their meeting as innocent as it seems?
Nene finds disembodied hands appearing in her old club photos! Then, hands start sprouting around her in real life too! They seem harmless, but is there something sinister behind them?

Tsukasa rescues Nene and Mitsuba from the Hell of Mirrors, but does the mercurial ghost have something worse in store for them? Meanwhile, Hanako and Kou race to find a way to follow Nene, but will they make it in time?

Nene made it back from the Hell of Mirrors in one piece, but she worries about what Hanako may be hiding from her. Just then, strange fish appear, calling her their princess and asking her to join them as the mermaid’s successor.
